love: I love my new red trainers so much!
Dogs love their owners and wag their tails.
I love it when the sun shines!
come: Will you come to my party on Saturday?
The bus will come to the stop soon.
Here come the ducks, waddling to the pond!
some: I would like some milk with my cereal.
Please pour some water into the cup.
There is some sand in my shoe.
one: Count down, three, two, one, go!
Each hand has just one thumb.
The number after zero is one.
once: Our cat jumped on the shelf just once.
Press the bell once, then wait at the door.
Once upon a time, a little frog lived here.
have: Do you have a pet rabbit at home?
I have a red bag for school.
give: Please give the teacher your homework book.
Can you give the dog a bowl of water?
Mum will give me a hug when I wake.
five: The number after four is five.
School is open five days, Monday to Friday.
glove: My hand is cold, so I need a glove.
I lost my left glove at the park.
Dad wears a thick glove to pick prickly weeds.
dive: The duck will dive under the water for food.
Can you dive deep to touch the sand?
The penguin will dive deep under the waves.
